Opoliensis, 18 februarii 1984 (Prot. CD 1580/83): conceditur ut celebratio Sanctae Barbarae, virginis et martyris, in Calendarium proprium dioecesis inseri valeat, quotannis die 4 decembris gradu memoriae obligatoriae peragenda.

celebration.name_latin: Sancta Restituta, virgo et martyr

summary_en: Confirms the election of St Restituta, virgin and martyr, as patroness before God of the town of Calenzana, or of the region commonly called Balagne, in the diocese of Ajaccio (Corsica); a sub-diocesan territory, so recorded as 'other' and flagged for review.
excerpt: Adiacensis, 22 augusti 1984 (Prot. CD 1261/84): confirmatur electio Sanctae Restitutae virginis et martyris Patronae apud Deum sive civitatis Calenzana nuncupatae sive regionis vulgo dictae Balagne.

summary_en: Response of the Congregation « De Calendario liturgico exarando pro anno 1984-1985 »: a one-year ruling for the liturgical year 1984-1985 on which Mass and Vespers are used on the evening of a Saturday or Sunday when a solemnity or feast falls next to a Sunday (8-9 Dec 1984 Immaculate Conception / Advent II; 2-3 Feb 1985 Presentation / Sunday IV; 23-24 June Sunday XII / Nativity of St John the Baptist; 29-30 June Sts Peter and Paul / Sunday XIII; 14-15 Sept Exaltation of the Cross / Sunday XXIV; 2-3 Nov All Souls / Sunday XXXI; 9-10 Nov Dedication of the Lateran / Sunday XXXIII): the Mass satisfying the precept has precedence, and for the Office n. 61 of the Normae universales is kept with a possible derogation in celebrations with the people; episcopal conferences and diocesan bishops may indicate the practice in their particular calendars. No protocol number or date is printed.
excerpt: DE CALENDARIO LITURGICO EXARANDO PRO ANNO 1984-1985. Redactores nonnulli « Ordinis Missae celebrandae et Officii Divini persolvendi » dubia proposuerunt de Calendario liturgico pro anno Domini 1984-1985, quae respiciunt formularia Missae et Vesperarum horis vespertinis sabbati vel dominicae adhibenda, quando sollemnitas quaedam, de praecepto servanda vel non, die sabbati aut feria secunda occurrit.

celebration.name_latin: Beata Maria Virgo sub titulo « Santa Maria del Sasso »

summary_en: In the churches of the Casentino territory of the diocese of Arezzo (the municipalities of Capolona, Subbiano, Ortignano-Raggiolo, Castel Focognano, Bibbiena, Poppi and Chiusi della Verna) the Blessed Virgin Mary under the title « Santa Maria del Sasso » may be celebrated every year on 23 June as a solemnity; a sub-diocesan territory, so recorded as 'other' and flagged for review.
excerpt: Arretina, 1 octobris 1984 (Prot. CD 1680/84): conceditur ut in ecclesiis territorii Casentinensis (municipiorum scilicet, quae Capolona, Subbiano, Ortignano-Raggiolo, Castel Focognano, Bibbiana, Poppi, Chiusi della Verna nuncupantur) celebratio beatae Mariae Virginis sub titulo « Santa Maria del Sasso » quotannis die 23 iunii gradu sollemnitatis peragi possit.

summary_en: A decree for the diocese of Orléans is listed under « Calendaria particularia — Dioeceses » with no description; the same protocol on p. 946 confirms the French text of the Proper of Masses and of the Liturgy of the Hours.
excerpt: Aurelianensis, 5 octobris 1984 (Prot. CD 1070/83).

summary_en: A decree for the French-speaking dioceses of Belgium is listed under « Calendaria particularia — Dioeceses » with no description; the same protocol on p. 946 confirms the French text of the Proper of Masses.
excerpt: Belgii dioeceses linguae gallicae, 3 novembris 1984 (Prot. CD 841/84).

celebration.name_latin: Immaculata Conceptio beatae Mariae Virginis

summary_en: One-year concession for 1985: in the dioceses of Spain the solemnity of the Immaculate Conception of the Blessed Virgin Mary may be celebrated on 8 December 1985, the Second Sunday of Advent.
excerpt: Hispaniae dioeceses, 25 septembris 1984 (Prot. CD 1546/84): conceditur ut sollemnitas Immaculatae Conceptionis beatae Mariae Virginis die 8 decembris 1985, dominica secunda Adventus, celebrari possit.

target.institute: Canonici Regulares S. Augustini

summary_en: The Canons Regular of St Augustine may insert three celebrations into the Order's proper calendar: St Martin of León, priest, optional memorial on 12 January; St John of Oisterwijk, priest and martyr, optional memorial in the whole Order and feast in the Windesheim-Victorine Congregation, on 9 July; St Bertrand, bishop, optional memorial on 16 October. The same decree (p. 948) confirms the Latin Mass and Office texts of Sts Martin and Bertrand.
excerpt:
Canonici Regulares S. Augustini, 10 octobris 1984 (Prot. CD 1208/84): libenter conceditur ut, in Calendarium proprium eiusdem Ordinis inseri valeant celebrationes quae sequuntur:
die 12 ianuarii: S. Martini Legionensis, presbyteri, memoria ad libitum; die 9 iulii: S. Ioannis Ostervicani, presbyteri et martyris, gradu memoriae ad libitum in universo Ordine, gradu vero festi in Congregatione Vindesemensi-Victorina; die 16 octobris: S. Bertrandi, episcopi, memoria ad libitum.

target.institute: Canonici Regulares S. Augustini (Congregatio Vindesemensis - S. Victoris)

celebration.name_latin: S. Bertrandus, episcopus

summary_en: In the proper calendar of the Windesheim-St Victor Congregation of Canons Regular of St Augustine the optional memorial of St Bertrand, bishop, may be transferred from 16 October to 16 January.
excerpt: Canonici Regulares S. Augustini (Congregatio Vindesemensis - S. Victoris), 30 octobris 1984 (Prot. CD 1791/84): conceditur ut in Calendario proprio celebratio memoriae ad libitum Sancti Bertrandi episcopi a die 16 octobris ad diem 16 ianuarii transferri possit.

target.institute: Ordo Sancti Benedicti (Congregatio anglica)

celebration.name_latin: Beata Maria Virgo « Auxilium Christianorum », titulus Abbatiae de Buckfast

summary_en: The solemnity of the title of Buckfast Abbey (Blessed Virgin Mary) may be transferred from 15 August to 24 May, to be celebrated under the title of the Blessed Virgin Mary Help of Christians; a single-abbey item, flagged for review.
excerpt: Ordo Sancti Benedicti (Congregatio anglica), 7 novembris 1984 (Prot. CD 1825/84): conceditur ut sollemnitas tituli Abbatiae beatae Mariae Virginis apud « Buckfast » a die 15 augusti ad diem 24 maii transferri possit, sub titulo beatae Mariae Virginis « Auxilii Christianorum » celebranda.

target.institute: Institutum Filiarum a Sancto Ioseph - « Rivalba »

celebration.name_latin: Beatus Clemens Marchisio

summary_en: The Institute of the Daughters of St Joseph of Rivalba may celebrate Blessed Clement Marchisio every year on 20 September as a feast.
excerpt: Institutum Filiarum a Sancto Ioseph - « Rivalba », 17 octobris 1984 (Prot. CD 1742/84): conceditur ut celebratio Beati Clementis Marchisio quotannis die 20 septembris gradu festi peragi valeat.

target.institute: « Misioneras de Acción Parroquial »

celebration.name_latin: Beata Maria Virgo sub titulo Mediatricis omnium gratiarum

summary_en: In the churches of the Institute « Misioneras de Acción Parroquial » the Blessed Virgin Mary under the title of Mediatrix of all graces may be celebrated every year on the last Saturday of May as a solemnity.
excerpt: « Misioneras de Acción Parroquial », 30 novembris 1984 (Prot. CD 1822/84): conceditur ut in ecclesiis eiusdem Instituti celebratio beatae Mariae Virginis sub titulo Mediatricis omnium gratiarum quotannis ultimo sabbato mensis maii gradu sollemnitatis peragi valeat.

target.institute: Moniales Ordinis Sancti Benedicti Dominae Nostrae a Calvario

celebration.name_latin: Beata Rosalia Caelestis, virgo et martyr

summary_en: The Benedictine Nuns of Our Lady of Calvary may celebrate Blessed Rosalie Célestine (Rosalia Caelestis), virgin and martyr, every year on 27 January as an obligatory memorial; the same decree (p. 949) confirms the Latin and French texts of her Mass and Office.
excerpt: Moniales Ordinis Sancti Benedicti Dominae Nostrae a Calvario, 12 octobris 1984 (Prot. CD 1679/84): conceditur ut celebratio Beatae Rosaliae Caelestis, virginis et martyris, quotannis die 27 ianuarii gradu memoriae obligatoriae peragi valeat.

celebration.name_latin: Beata Maria Virgo sub titulo Immaculati Cordis

summary_en: Confirms the election of the Blessed Virgin Mary under the title of the Immaculate Heart as patroness before God of the nation of Angola.
excerpt: Angola, 21 novembris 1984 (Prot. CD 1547/84): confirmatur electio Beatae Mariae Virginis sub titulo Immaculati Cordis Patronae apud Deum nationis Angolensis.

celebration.name_latin: Sancta Lucia, virgo et martyr

summary_en: Confirms the election of St Lucy, virgin and martyr, as patroness before God of the diocese of Mossoró (Brazil).
excerpt: Mossorensis, 11 octobris 1984 (Prot. CD 1533/84): confirmatur electio Sanctae Luciae, virginis et martyris, Patronae apud Deum dioecesis Mossorensis.

celebration.name_latin: S. Carolus Borromeo, episcopus

summary_en: Confirms the election of St Charles Borromeo, bishop, as patron before God of the diocese of São Carlos (Brazil).
excerpt: Sanctus Carolus in Brasilia, 8 novembris 1984 (Prot. CD 1714/84): confirmatur electio Sancti Caroli Borromeo episcopi Patroni apud Deum dioecesis Sancti Caroli in Brasilia.

celebration.name_latin: Beata Maria Virgo sub titulo Immaculatae Conceptionis

summary_en: Confirms the election of the Blessed Virgin Mary under the title of the Immaculate Conception as patroness before God of the Republic of Tanzania.
excerpt: Tanzania, 8 novembris 1984 (Prot. CD 1732/84): confirmatur electio beatae Mariae Virginis sub titulo Immaculatae Conceptionis Patronae apud Deum Reipublicae Tanzaniensis.
